name: Goo
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Vydrin, Valentin (2013) sketch of Goo (Baa), a newly discovered Southern Mande language (cited by Glottolog and Wikipedia as primary source)

sources.citation: Vydrin, Valentin. 2013. Goo : présentation d'une langue. Mandenkan 50: 171-194. doi:10.4000/mandenkan.293 (publisher PDF from LLACAN mirror + HAL deposit halshs-00908040; OpenEdition HTML also read via web lookups)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or at Harvard
sources.note: Sec. 2 'Quelques traits phonologiques' (pp. 173-175): 'le goo, comme le toura, a quatre tons unis (extra-haut, haut, bas, extra-bas)'; discussion of back unrounded vowels and a ±ATR hypothesis with formant data; nothing whatsoever on stress or accent.

sources.citation: Аплонова Е.С., Выдрин В.Ф. 2017. Гоо язык [Goo]. In: Выдрин В.Ф. и др. (ред.), Языки мира: Языки манде. СПб.: Нестор-История, 457-469.
sources.note: Short-template chapter. 5.1.0 (pp. 457-459): vowel and consonant inventories; 'Выделяются четыре уровневых тона... Модулированные тоны (на одном слоге) отсутствуют.' 5.1.1: metrical foot (V, CV, CVV) is the basic rhythmic unit, nasal harmony within the foot, tone-combination table. No 'ударение' line at all (the sister Tura chapter in the same volume does say 'Ударение отсутствует', but that is Tura, not Goo).

sources.citation: Aplonova, Ekaterina. 2020. Dictionnaire goo – français. Mandenkan 63: 3-67. doi:10.4000/mandenkan.2188
sources.note: Sec. 2.2 'Aperçu du système phonologique' (pp. 7-8): vowel and consonant tables; 'Comme toutes les langues mandé sud, le goo est une langue tonale. Il a quatre tons : extra-haut, haut, bas, extra-bas... Certains lexèmes subissent l'abaissement du ton de leur syllabe finale sous l'effet du sandhi final'. Nothing on stress/accent.

sources.citation: Aplonova, Ekaterina. 2017. Morphologie verbale de la langue goo. Mandenkan 58: 3-24.
sources.note: Tone notation and verbal tonal classes/grammatical tone (sec. 2.2); no phonology section, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Vydrin, V.F. 2014. Гоо, неизвестный язык манде [Goo, an unknown Mande language]. In: A. Zheltov (ed.), Антропология и лингвистика: Материалы петербургских экспедиций в Африку. СПб.: МАЭ РАН, 67-127. HAL halshs-01096626.
sources.note: Sec. 2 (pp. 71-76): 2.1 vowels, 2.2 consonants, 2.3 'Слог и стопа' (metrical foot V/CV/CVV is the basic rhythmic unit; speakers perceive the foot's tonal contour as a whole), 2.4 'Тоны' (four level tones, no contour tones on a single syllable, table of foot tone combinations). The word 'ударение' does not occur; no stress statement.

sources.citation: Aplonova, Ekaterina. 2019. Dictionary as a source of a grammatical description of a language: the case of Goo. MA thesis, National Research University Higher School of Economics, Moscow.

sources.note: May contain a fuller phonological introduction than the published 2020 dictionary; low expectation of a stress statement since the author states she did not work on phonology.

sources.citation: Foungbé, Irenée Sabine. 2017. Les morphèmes du nominal en goo, langue mandé-sud de Côte d'Ivoire. Mémoire de master, Département des Sciences du langage, Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny, Abidjan. 70 pp.

sources.note: Only remaining Glottolog-listed description not opened; Abidjan MA theses usually open with a phonological sketch in the Ivorian descriptive tradition, which sometimes includes an explicit 'accent' paragraph — the only realistic place a first-hand stress statement for Goo might exist.
